GET reference

App Store Version Localizations

Read a version localization

Read the store listing for an exact version and locale. Address the locale directly; Parsequerade resolves Apple’s localization ID.

GET/apps/{appId}/versions/{versionId}/localizations/{locale}

Proposed First release · Service not implemented

Request

Routes are relative to your connection. Use a facade API key; the service manages Apple authentication.

cURL
BASE='https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example'

curl --fail-with-body "$BASE/apps/1234567890/versions/version_123/localizations/en-US" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ASC_FACADE_KEY"
JavaScript
const base = "https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example";
const response = await fetch(`${base}/apps/1234567890/versions/version_123/localizations/en-US`, {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.ASC_FACADE_KEY}` }
});

const body = await response.json();
if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(body.error?.message ?? `HTTP ${response.status}`);
}
console.log(body);
Python
import json
import os
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError

base = "https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example"
request = Request(
    f"{base}/apps/1234567890/versions/version_123/localizations/en-US",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['ASC_FACADE_KEY']}"},
)
try:
    with urlopen(request) as response:
        print(json.load(response))
except HTTPError as error:
    detail = json.load(error)
    raise RuntimeError(detail["error"]["message"]) from error

asc.example.com is a placeholder for your deployment. Examples use fictional IDs.

Path parameters

NameTypeDescription
appIdRequiredstringApple’s app ID. Returned by List apps.
versionIdRequiredstringAn explicit version ID belonging to this app. Select it from the version list.
localeRequiredstringThe exact locale to read. No fallback to a different locale.

Response

One flat object for the selected resource.

200 · application/json
{
  "id": "localization_456",
  "appId": "1234567890",
  "versionId": "version_123",
  "locale": "en-US",
  "description": "Keep your notes organized.",
  "keywords": "notes,productivity,writing",
  "marketingUrl": null,
  "supportUrl": "https://example.com/support",
  "promotionalText": "A clearer place for your ideas.",
  "whatsNew": "Faster search and improved offline editing."
}

Illustrative response. Optional read fields may be absent or null; unknown enum values are preserved.

Response fields

NameTypeDescription
idstringApple’s resource ID. Keep this string unchanged when addressing a resource.
appIdstringThe app that owns this resource.
versionIdstringThe selected App Store version.
descriptionstringThe localized store description.
localestringThe exact Apple locale identifier, such as en-US.
keywordsstringThe localized keywords, returned as Apple’s comma-separated string.
marketingUrlstring · uriThe localized marketing website. Null remains null.
promotionalTextstringThe localized promotional text shown on the product page.
supportUrlstring · uriThe localized support website.
whatsNewstringThe localized release notes for this version.

Behavior

  • Choose versionId from the app’s version list. The adapter checks that it belongs to appId and resolves locale against that version’s localizations.
  • A missing locale returns 404 localization_not_found. The service does not substitute the primary locale or create a localization during a GET.
  • App name, subtitle, and privacy URLs belong to app-info localizations. They are separate from the version listing shown here.

Errors

HTTPTypeDescription
400invalid_queryUnsupported filter, sort, limit, or cursor.
401unauthorizedMissing or invalid facade API key.
403forbidden / upstream_forbiddenThe caller or configured Apple key cannot read this resource.
404localization_not_foundThe requested resource or exact locale is absent or outside the caller’s scope.
429rate_limitedA facade or Apple rate limit was reached. Respect Retry-After when returned.
502–504upstream errorApple authentication, response parsing, availability, or timeout failure; this is not an empty result.

Apple mapping

Upstream route and translation

The adapter calls GET /v1/appStoreVersionLocalizations/{id}. Read Apple’s original endpoint ↗

Resolve the parent’s localization collection using the exact locale, validate ownership, and then supply the resolved ID to this Apple endpoint.

Apple’s data, attributes, and relationships envelopes are translated inside the service. Read access does not make these fields writable.
